home.headline: Planning software for wedding planners and venues
home.lede: Guestnote keeps the task list, run sheet, budget and vendors for every wedding you plan. Deadlines count back from the wedding date, and every vendor gets their own link to their part of the day.

checklist.title: Deadlines that move with the wedding date
checklist.body: You set a task for “three months before the wedding” instead of a fixed date. If the couple changes the date, the tasks move with it. A new couple starts from your own template or from one of the starter templates we include.

runSheet.title: A run sheet for each day
runSheet.body: Every item has a time, a length, a place and someone responsible for it. When two items overlap, the list shows it straight away.

budget.title: The budget by category
budget.body: For each category you see what is planned, what has been spent and what has been paid. Payments still due are listed separately.

couple.title: You choose what the couple sees
couple.body: Every task and every file is either internal or shared. Internal notes stay with your team. Tasks for the couple you assign to the couple, and they tick them off in their own portal. Per wedding you choose what the couple sees: planning, moodboards, run sheet, vendors and budget.

free.a: Yes, while Guestnote is in early access. You don’t need a credit card. We’ll give you at least 30 days’ notice before we start charging, and you decide then whether to stay.

data.a: On servers in Frankfurt, inside the European Union. We don’t sell your data or your couples’ data, and we don’t use it for advertising.

couples.q: Does my couple need an account?
couples.a: Yes, when you invite them: each partner gets their own invitation and signs in with a code by email. They see only what you share. Vendors need no account; they get a link.

languages.a: Dutch, French and English. Every planner picks their own.

leave.q: What if I want to stop?
leave.a: There is no minimum term. If you want to take your data with you, ask us for an export.

closing.title: Free while we are in early access
closing.body: Create a studio and add a wedding you are working on now. That is the quickest way to find out whether Guestnote works for you.

together.title: Everyone around the same wedding
together.body: Your team works in the same wedding, and every vendor sees their part through their own link. When a colleague changes the run sheet, the change is in the photographer’s link straight away.

price.body: Couples and vendors pay nothing and never count. During early access everything is free, no credit card needed.

about.title: About Guestnote
about.body1: Guestnote is a Belgian product for wedding planners and venues. We make it because we saw how much planning work lives in separate spreadsheets, emails and chat groups, and how much time it takes to keep them in line.
about.body2: Your data is kept on servers in Frankfurt. We don’t sell it and we don’t use it for advertising. New features are tried on real weddings first.
about.contactBody: For a question, a demo or a bug you ran into. You’ll hear back from someone who works on Guestnote.
